topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, sets expectations regarding nomenclature complexity, and provides opening framing.

topics.label: Foundations and central mechanics of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational principles and central molecular mechanics of the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the three recognition pathways that drive C3 convertase assembly and establish the trigger threshold for activation.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the primary downstream mechanisms through which activated complement eliminates pathogens and promotes immune defense.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how regulatory proteins protect host cells from unintended complement-mediated damage.

topics.label: Clinical complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct pathological consequences and disease phenotypes associated with deficiencies in various complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how pathogenic microorganisms evolve targeted strategies to evade and neutralize complement defenses.

topics.label: Closing remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture, previews the upcoming topic on adaptive immunity, and provides closing framing.
